However, encouraging criminals to counteract the police doesn't address these issues constructively. Instead, it perpetuates a cycle of crime and resistance, which doesn't lead to positive change. Moreover, from a legal perspective, encouraging or aiding criminals can be considered a criminal act itself, depending on the jurisdiction.
